text: was well-respected, and everybody honored him. So he was the leader of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
Now, he traveled at one point in time, he traveled up to [[Sham|شام]], the area of Syria and Palestine.
And when he was there, [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لحي]], when he traveled there, he saw a group of people, a group of people called the [[Amaliq|عماليق]].
And he noticed that they had idols, stones that they used to worship besides Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]].

They used to worship different stones. So [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لحي]], as we mentioned, in the Arabian Peninsula, there was no [[shirk|شرك]]. Everyone worshiped Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] alone.

But when he went up there to [[Sham|شام]], then he saw these people worshiping these stones and stuff. So he was surprised. He never saw anything like this before. So he said, 'What are these things that you are worshiping? What is the purpose of this?'

They said, 'Yeah, these are, you know, these are our idols. When we're hungry, you know, they provide us with food. When we are in a state of fear or we are oppressed, then they help us. When we are thirsty, when we don't have anything to drink, they provide us with water.'
So then he said, 'Oh, really?' He was surprised at this. So then he said, 'Can you give me one? Can I have one? Because we have a water problem in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], you know.'

'There's no more [[Zamzam|زمزم]] anymore. We need water. We have to get water from outside. So you're saying that these things, if you pray to them, they'll give you water. So can I have one? I'll take it back to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] and maybe we can get some water, too.' They said, 'Yeah, sure.'

They gave him an idol. They gave him an idol, and the name of this idol was [[Hubal|هبل]]. And he brought this idol back with him to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. This is the first idol that came into the Arabian Peninsula, the idol that was known as [[Hubal|هبل]].

So when he comes back to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] with this idol in his hand, and as we mentioned before, [[Amr ibn Luhayy|عمرو بن لحي]], he is a person who is obeyed by the people. He comes back with this idol, and he tells the people...
